narration.full_text: In this lesson, we'll dive into the world of real numbers. We'll start by defining and classifying them, including the important distinctions between rational and irrational numbers. You'll also learn about the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic and its practical applications. We'll then explore how to find the Highest Common Factor and Least Common Multiple using prime factorization. Finally, we'll tackle proving the irrationality of numbers like the square root of two, and apply these concepts to solve real-world problems. Get ready to build a strong foundation in number systems!
